channel.title: The Batch | DeepLearning.AI
channel.description: Weekly AI news for engineers, executives, and enthusiasts.

item.title: Introducing the DeepLearning.AI Skill Builder Tool!: Want to strengthen your AI skills? Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced developer, DeepLearning.AI’s free Skill Builder can tell you what to do next.
item.description: We just released a Skill Builder tool to help you understand in which areas of AI you’re strong, where you can learn more, and what to do next to keep building your skills.

item.title: Can Local AI Stand In for the Cloud?: Stanford and Together.AI researchers chart edge models’ performance in intelligence per watt
item.description: Projected demand for output from large language models is spurring a massive buildout of data centers. Researchers asked whether smaller models running on local devices could meaningfully lighten that load.

item.title: Investors Panic Over Agentic AI: Claude Cowork plugins trigger a SaaS stock selloff, but partnerships lead to slight rebound
item.description: Makers of software that runs large companies saw their share prices plunge as investors worried that AI systems could undermine their businesses. This week, their stocks rebounded somewhat as Anthropic partnered with some of the same companies.

item.title: Global AI Summit Shows Optimism: Rising giant India presents itself as AI Counterweight to U.S. and China
item.description: The fourth global AI summit marked a decisive shift from focusing on theoretical hazards to spreading AI’s benefits throughout the world.

item.title: Gemini Takes the Lead: Google releases Gemini 3.1 Pro in preview, tops Intelligence Index at same price
item.description: Google updated its flagship Gemini model, topping several benchmarks while undercutting competitors on performance per dollar.

item.title: Anthropic, U.S. square off over AI safeguards: Mercury 2, an ultra-fast diffusion language model
item.description: Remote Control, a tool to vibe-code from your phone. Anthropic’s charge that DeepSeek and others distilled its models. Qwen 3.5’s suite of medium MoE models. Protenix-v1, Bytedance’s open-source take on AlphaFold 3.

item.title: Gemini update adds a new reasoning tier: Claude Code expands to security reviews
item.description: Why some AI models give worse answers to non-native English speakers. First Proof, a frontier math challenge OpenAI may have partially solved. LLaDA2.1’s RL framework for diffusion language models. Anthropic’s study suggesting it’s better to let agents cook.

item.title: Sleep Signals Predict Illness: SleepFM detects signs of neurological disorders years before symptoms manifest
item.description: Difficulty sleeping often precedes heart disease, psychiatric disorders, and many other illnesses. Researchers used data gathered during sleep studies to detect such conditions.

item.title: Faster Reasoning at the Edge: Liquid AI’s small reasoning model mixes attention with convolutional layers for efficiency
item.description: Reasoning models in the 1 to 2 billion-parameter range typically require more than 1 gigabyte of RAM to run. Liquid AI released one that runs in less than 900 megabytes, and does it with exceptional speed and efficiency.

item.title: How AI Will Create Jobs: Whenever technology unlocks human creativity, it creates far more jobs than it destroys. AI-driven job growth has already started.
item.description: Will AI create new job opportunities? My daughter Nova loves cats, and her favorite color is yellow.

item.title: Big AI Spends Big On Lobbying: Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and Nvidia pour millions into government influence
item.description: Top tech and AI companies spent more than $100 million to influence government policy in 2025, the first time they exceeded that figure.

item.title: GLM-5 Scales Up: Z.ai’s updated model boasts top open-weights Intelligence Index score
item.description: Z.ai more than doubled the size of its flagship large language model to deliver outstanding performance among open-weights competitors.

item.title: Sonnet update adds context and coding power: Sony can detect AI songs’ inspirations
item.description: Dreamer, a new agent platform that acts like an OS. A proposal to control access to infectious disease data. Tiny Aya, a small model family for India, Africa, West Asia, etc. Code to Canvas, where Figma teams up with Claude Code.
